agents.title: Competition Analysis
agents.description: Identify your true market position and uncover competitor blind spots. Get a feature-by-feature breakdown of where you win, lose, and how to differentiate.

questions.text: Which specific competitors concern you most and why?
What market or geography should we focus on?
What differentiators do you believe you have over competitors?

agents.title: GTM Strategy
agents.description: Launch with confidence using a complete Go-To-Market roadmap. Define your target audience, pricing, and distribution channels to maximize market impact.

questions.text: Who is your primary target customer segment?
What channels (digital, offline, partnerships) are you prioritising?
What is your launch timeline and budget range?

agents.title: Product Launch Strategy
agents.description: Turn your new product idea into a structured, high-impact rollout plan. Map out your pre-launch buzz, launch day execution, and post-launch retention tactics.

questions.text: What are you launching?
What is the primary objective of this launch?
What is your planned launch timeline?

agents.title: Social Media Strategy
agents.description: Build an engaging social presence that converts followers into customers. Get tailored content pillars, posting cadences, and platform-specific growth tactics.

questions.text: Which social platforms are most important for your brand?
What is your current posting frequency and content mix?
What specific social media outcomes do you want to improve?

agents.title: Content Calendar
agents.description: A content planner. It researches what's trending, proposes a monthly calendar of topics, and drafts a brief for each piece...

questions.text: What are your main content themes or topics, and who is the target audience?
Which channels will the content run on (blog, social, email, YouTube) and at what frequency?
What business outcome should the content drive (awareness, leads, SEO, retention)?

agents.title: Festival/Topical Campaign Strategy
agents.description: Plans festival-season and topical marketing campaigns with timing, messaging, and channel recommendations. Maps out topical authority clusters, pillar topics, and internal linking structures...

questions.text: Which festivals, occasions, or topical moments do you want to target?
What is your product or offer, and how does it connect to these occasions?
What is your budget range and primary goal (sales, reach, engagement)?

agents.title: GEO/AEO
agents.description: Optimize your brand to rank higher in AI search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity. Ensure AI tools accurately understand and recommend your brand to users.

questions.text: What questions or topics do you want your brand to show up for in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews)?
What is your current website and content setup, and do you have structured data or schema in place?
Which competitors or sources are currently being cited for your topics?

agents.title: SEO Strategy
agents.description: A comprehensive SEO agent. Give it a website URL and it crawls pages, identifies issues, researches keywords, audits on-page factors, analyzes backlinks, and builds an actionable optimization roadmap...

questions.text: What are your primary target keywords or topics, and your main geography?
What is the current state of your site (traffic, rankings, known technical issues)?
What are your top business goals for organic search (leads, sales, visibility)?

agents.title: Seasonal Campaign
agents.description: Builds seasonal marketing plans covering Q1–Q4 peaks, promotional windows, and content cadences for maximum impact...

questions.text: Which seasons or peak periods are most important for your business?
What products or offers do you run during these periods?
What is your budget range and primary KPI for seasonal campaigns?

agents.title: Brand Audit
agents.description: Evaluate your brand's current health, consistency, and messaging across all channels. Discover actionable ways to strengthen your identity.

questions.text: How would you describe your current brand positioning?
What do customers currently say about your brand?
Which brand elements feel outdated or misaligned?

agents.title: Brand Positioning
agents.description: Defines your unique market position. Analyzes competitors, identifies white space, and crafts a compelling positioning statement...

questions.text: How would you describe your brand's current positioning and target audience?
Who are your main competitors, and how do you want to be different from them?
What core value or promise do you want your brand to stand for?

agents.title: ICP & Personas
agents.description: Defines your Ideal Customer Profile and builds detailed buyer personas with firmographics, pain points, and buying triggers...

questions.text: Describe your best current customers — who are they and why do they buy?
What industries, company sizes, or demographics do you want to target?
What problem does your product solve, and what triggers a purchase?

agents.title: Campaign Structure Architect
agents.description: Designs the optimal campaign structure for your paid media. Covers account hierarchy, ad group logic, naming conventions...

questions.text: Which paid channels are you running or planning (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, etc.)?
What are your products or services, and your campaign objectives (leads, sales, awareness)?
What is your total monthly ad budget, and how is it split today?

agents.title: Bidding & Budget Optimizer
agents.description: Analyzes your current bidding strategies and budget allocation across campaigns and recommends optimizations for better ROI...

questions.text: What are your primary performance goals (target CPA, ROAS, or volume)?
What is your current bidding setup and monthly budget across channels?
What are your current results, and the main performance problem you want to fix?

agents.title: Company Research Agent
agents.description: A company research agent. Give it a company name and it puts together a one-pager covering their product, team...

questions.text: Which company or companies do you want researched?
What do you most want to understand (business model, financials, strategy, products)?
What decision or goal is this research supporting (sales, partnership, competitive, investment)?

agents.title: Competitive Intelligence Agent
agents.description: A competitive intel agent. It watches competitor websites for changes, tracks their announcements and press...

questions.text: Which competitors do you want to track or profile?
What aspects matter most (pricing, messaging, products, campaigns, hiring)?
How will you use this intelligence (sales battlecards, strategy, positioning)?

agents.title: Email Marketing
agents.description: Lifecycle flows, segmentation, and campaigns to grow email revenue

questions.text: What email platform and list size are you working with?
What are your current email types and sending frequency?
What's your primary email goal (revenue, retention, nurture, re-engagement)?

agents.title: Influencer Marketing
agents.description: Creator partnerships, tiering, and ROI strategy across platforms

questions.text: Which platforms and creator tiers are you targeting (nano, micro, macro)?
What is your product and budget range for influencer campaigns?
What outcome matters most (awareness, sales, UGC, credibility)?

agents.title: Affiliate Marketing
agents.description: Program design, commissions, and partner recruitment

questions.text: Do you have an existing affiliate program, or starting fresh?
What is your product, margin, and target commission structure?
What types of affiliates do you want to recruit (bloggers, coupon, influencers, review sites)?

agents.title: Digital PR
agents.description: Media relations, story angles, and earned-media coverage

questions.text: What newsworthy story, product, or milestone do you want coverage for?
Which outlets, publications, or journalists matter to your audience?
What is your PR goal (awareness, SEO backlinks, reputation, launch)?

agents.title: Online Reputation Management
agents.description: Review strategy, sentiment monitoring, and reputation building

questions.text: What reputation concern or goal brought you here (reviews, negative content, proactive)?
Which review platforms and channels matter most for your business?
What is your current rating/sentiment and the outcome you want?

agents.title: E-commerce Strategy
agents.description: Conversion, pricing, and channel strategy for online revenue

questions.text: What do you sell, and on which channels (own store, marketplaces, both)?
What are your current revenue, conversion rate, and biggest bottleneck?
What's your primary growth goal (traffic, conversion, AOV, retention)?

agents.title: Brand Identity
agents.description: Personality, visual and verbal identity, and guidelines

questions.text: How would you describe your brand's personality and current identity?
Who is your target audience and what feeling should the brand evoke?
What's prompting this (rebrand, new brand, inconsistency, refresh)?

agents.title: PPC & Paid Ads
agents.description: Channel mix, targeting, and budget strategy across paid media

questions.text: Which paid channels are you running or want to run?
What is your monthly budget and primary objective (leads, sales, awareness)?
What are your current results and main challenge (CAC, ROAS, scale)?

agents.title: Conversion Rate Optimization
agents.description: Funnel analysis, experimentation, and personalization

questions.text: Which page or funnel step do you most want to improve?
What is your current conversion rate and traffic volume?
What do you think is causing drop-off, and what's your conversion goal?

agents.title: Marketing Analytics
agents.description: Measurement framework, attribution, and reporting

questions.text: What channels and tools are you trying to measure across?
What decisions do you need the analytics to inform?
What's your biggest measurement gap today (attribution, reporting, data quality)?

agents.title: Market Entry Strategy
agents.description: Opportunity, entry mode, and phased roadmap for new markets

questions.text: Which new market or geography are you considering entering?
What is your product and current home-market position?
What's your risk appetite, timeline, and budget for entry?

agents.title: Pricing Strategy
agents.description: Value-based pricing, tiers, and monetization model design

questions.text: What is your current pricing model, and what's prompting a review?
Who are your main competitors and how do they price?
What's your goal (raise margin, grow volume, enter new segment, simplify)?

agents.title: Partnership Strategy
agents.description: Alliance types, partner profiles, and activation roadmap

questions.text: What kind of partnerships are you after (channel, tech, co-marketing, strategic)?
What do you bring to a partner, and what do you need from one?
What's the business goal these partnerships should drive?

agents.title: Innovation Strategy
agents.description: Opportunity identification, portfolio, and roadmap

questions.text: What area do you want to innovate in (product, service, model, process)?
What capabilities and resources can you bring to bear?
What's driving the need (competition, growth stall, new tech, customer shift)?

agents.title: Compliance & Legal
agents.description: Informational guidance on advertising, privacy, and marketing compliance (not legal advice)

questions.text: What marketing activity or region do you need compliance guidance for?
What data do you collect, and through what channels?
What's your main concern (advertising claims, privacy/consent, disclosures, IP)?
